abroad Non-EU international students residing abroad who intend to enroll in a Bachelor’s Degree, Master’s Degree, or Single-cycle Master’s Degree program must follow the procedure below: 1. PRE-EVALUATION ON PICA Before submitting the application on Universitaly, students are required to submit a pre-evaluation application through the PICA portal at https://pica.cineca.it/unipg/2026-visa-01/ by accessing the procedure “PRE-ENROLLMENT PROCEDURE FOR VISA APPLICANT INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS ” no later than March 31, 2026, attaching the following documentation: a) a copy of a valid Passport; b) documentation of the foreign educational qualification valid for accessing the course, as specified in the section: https://www.unipg.it/en/international-students/becoming-a-unipg-student/list-of-study-documents c) if available, documentation regarding language requirements, as specified in the section: https://www.unipg.it/en/international-students/becoming-a-unipg-student/language-requirements d) curriculum vitae. Upon submission of the application, the student will receive a confirmation email. Each candidate can submit only one application and for only one course SHOULDN'T THE QUOTA FOR EACH STUDY PROGRAM BE REACHED, THE PROCEDURE ON PICA WILL BE REOPENED, IN ORDER TO ALLOW CANDIDATES TO APPLY EVEN AFTER 31 st MARCH. A COMMUNICATION WILL BE PUBLISHED IN THIS PAGE. CANDIDATES SHALL CONTACT THE INTERNATIONAL STUDENT OFFICE AT THE FOLLOWING E-MAIL ADDRESS: segr-studenti.stranieri@unipg.it Candidates are kindly invited not to request information already present in this webpage, nor to submit applications or study documents by e-mail. 2. VALIDATION ON PICA Starting from April 12, 2026, students will be able to view their evaluation outcome in PICA, which may be one of the following: ADMITTED UPON CONDITION : the student is required to take the Italian language proficiency test (see point 3) or integrate the missing documentation SENT TO COMMITTEE : the student must wait for the Committee to evaluate the academic requirements for admission to the Master's degree program. ADMITTED: the student is required to proceed with the enrollment on Universitaly (see point 4). REJECTED : the student cannot proceed with the enrollment on Universitaly for the reasons that will be specified in PICA. 3. ITALIAN LANGUAGE PROFICIENCY TEST Candidates in possession of the Italian language proficiency certification mentioned in point c) above are not required to take the Italian language test and may proceed with the enrollment on Universitaly (see point 4). Candidates NOT in possession of the Italian language proficiency certification mentioned in point c) above must take the Italian language proficiency test. The Italian language proficiency test for the purpose of obtaining the certification will be provided by UniPG in a remote (online) format. Due to the massive amount of applications within the deadline of March 31, 2026: the Italian language test sessions are postponed to April 22, 2026 and April 29, 2026; the Italian language test booking is open to April 10-16 2026 at the following link: https://unipg-iscrizioni.ilmiotest.it/register ; The procedure will require the candidate to indicate their preferred date for the test (either April 22 or April 29, 2026); in the event of failing to appear on the chosen date and time, it will not be possible to take the test on another date. Once the test registration procedure is completed, the candidate will receive a confirmation email containing useful instructions for the correct execution of the test. 4. ENROLLMENT ON UNIVERSITALY Once the positive evaluation outcome has been obtained in PICA, students may proceed with the online pre-enrollment on the UNIVERSITALY portal ( https://www.universitaly.it ). This step is mandatory to initiate the study visa application at the Italian Diplomatic Representation in the country of residence. 5. VALIDATION ON UNIVERSITALY Only students who have received a positive evaluation outcome in PICA will be validated on Universitaly; applications submitted on Universitaly by students who have not been previously evaluated in PICA will not be taken into consideration. 6. VISA APPLICATION AND ENROLLMENT Students validated on Universitaly must contact the Italian Diplomatic Representation in their country of residence to obtain their visa. Once they have arrived in Italy, students may start the enrollment procedures. Italian citizens, EU citizens, and non-EU citizens legally residing in Italy who hold a qualification obtained abroad International students holding a qualification obtained abroad, who do not require a study visa are required to have their foreign qualification evaluated according to the following procedure: 1. EVALUATION OF THE FOREIGN QUALIFICATION The candidate is required to submit the application for the evaluation of theit foreign qualification through the PICA portal at https://pica.cineca.it/unipg/ by accessing the procedure “ EVALUATION OF FOREIGN QUALIFICATIONS ” starting from June 1, 2026 , attaching the following documentation: copy of a valid identity document; documentation of the foreign educational qualification valid for accessing the course, as specified in the section: https://www.unipg.it/en/international-students/becoming-a-unipg-student/list-of-study-documents . Applications submitted via email or in any other form will not be taken into consideration for evaluation. 2. Versione italiana After the preliminary procedures for the assessment of the foreign qualification (please refer to the page students-wishing-to-enroll ) and have obtained admission, you can complete the application of online enrollment proceed therefore to: 1) fill the enrollment request online by upload all the required documents (listed below) (information on registration procedures will be available at web page https://www.unipg.it/didattica/procedure-amministrative/procedure/immatricolazioni ) 2) pay the First installment via PAGO PA 3) send an email to internationalstudents@unipg.it Attention : in the case of enrolments in two-year Master’s Degree courses it is necessary to be in possession of the “nullaosta” issued by the course (see below). Enrolment procedures such as completion, submission and administrative checks of mandatory documents will be carried out with an online preliminary procedure. After the administrative check the enrollment will be completed. Once enrolled, you must go to the Student Office of your degree program to deliver the original documentation, scheduling an appointment in person for the evaluation of the documents. So candidates are required to take original hardcopies of all the below listed documents with them when they are summoned. The Student Office has the right to verify that all submitted documents are genuine, as well as to request any additional documents deemed necessary to confirm the authenticity of submitted qualifications and the possession of entry requirements. Mandatory documents for enrollment valid passport (or identity card, only for EU citizens); fiscal code (for information on the issue see page residency-documents ); for non-EU students with entry visa for study purposes: study Visa for “University enrolment” released by the Italian Diplomatic mission (Embassy or Consulate) in the Country where the candidate has his/her residence and a copy of the receipts of residence permit request (for information on the issue see the page residency-documents ); for non-EU citizens regularly living in Italy and Chinese students in the Marco Polo Project: valid residence permit card. If you are renewing your residence permit card, you will need a copy of your expired permit together with the post office receipts of your renewal application receiptsof your residence permit request; All the documentation of the foreign qualification already prevalueted as listed on the page list-of-study-documents Statement of comparability of academic qualification by CIMEA, or Declaration of Value , by the Diplomatic/Consular representation that is competent for the territory or Certification of Foreign Centres of the ENIC/NARIC network or (for the 55 signatory countries of the Lisbon Recognition Convention) Statement of correspondence available for download in the ARDI database (Automatic Recognition Database Italia); Statement of verification of academic qualification by CIMEA. If the issuing of the Certificate of Verification is not possible for the country of qualification, the legalization/apostille of the qualification itself will be required. if necessary certification attesting a level of knowledge of the Italian language not lower than B2 as determined by the CLIQ if necessary, certification attesting to a level of knowledge of the English language (for enrolment in degree courses entirely taught in English) Nullaosta for two-year Master’s Degree courses If you want to enroll in one of the Master’s Degree courses that have the procedure of application for online “nullaosta” (see the page with the list of courses) BEFORE filling the enrollment request you must proceed to the application form online . 1) Enter the SOL (Servizi On Line) If you have NEVER been a student of the University of Perugia and you have never registered at the SOL-OnLine Secretariat, click on "REGISTRATION"; If you already have the credentials (Username and password) click on "AUTHENTICATION" and make the "login". 2) Fill the request of nullaosta through SOL by following the instructions at web page Notify us by email ( internationalstudents@unipg.it ) after you have completed the procedure. We will give you indications for enrollment. Students may expect to pay a yearly tuition usually between 150 and 2200 Euros, depending on the family annual income and merit. To choose the Fascia Flat students must: Login with your username and password to the portal SOL (Services On Line) in the menu section "Registrar’s office" "Self-certification" Check to submit the request for "FLAT band" (check box) Select from the drop-down menu the country where your family produces incomes/ assets. Only in case of enrollment or late registration after March 2, 2026, to choose the Fascia Flat you must send, at the same time as the payment of the 1st instalment of enrollment/registration, request of the appropriate form of Flat Tax at the email address segr-studenti.stranieri@unipg.it The form must then be filled, signed and sent back in pdf format to the same email address together with a valid identity document. Contributions/fees, in this case, will vary according to the income bracket as established by the Student Contribution Regulations The ISEEU Parificato certificate can only be released by a Centro Autorizzato di Assistenza Fiscale ( CAF/CAAF ) affiliated with l'Università degli Studi di Perugia. The request must be submitted, after receiving the matriculation number, to the CAF/ CAAF within the deadlines set out in the Student Contribution Regulations To obtain the ISEE Parificato you must go to a CAF/CAAF (Centro di assistenza fiscale) affiliated ( list CAAF ), with the request documentations . The service is free for the student. The CAF/CAAF itself will send the ISEEU Parificato directly to the University and will deliver to the student a copy of the ISEEU Parificato Attestation. List of countries with particularly poor or low human development established by Decree of the Ministry of University and Research (M.U.R.) In this case, if the appeal is accepted, the student will be required to submit a copy of the residence permit highlighting the recognized international protection status. Facilities for special needs students Our University guarantees support and assistance to special needs and differently-abled students during their university career through the adoption of a series of services and initiatives coordinated and monitored by a Delegate appointed by the Rector. The Rector's Delegate, along with the professors nominated as advisors by each Department, the University Commission (composed of three professors), the Administrative Director, and the Manager of the University's Information Booth for Differently-abled Students, each year plans and promotes activities, in accordance with current regulations, and research programmes. The Information Booth for differently-abled students is located within the University Orientation Office. The information booth staff offers assistance to differently-abled students with regard to orientation, choosing courses, and, after graduation, their transition to the labour force. The booth serves as a hand-in point for the forms which must be completed by students during enrolment so that they can take advantage of an exoneration from or a reduction in university fees due (if eligible) as well as to explain any difficulties in or obstacles to studying at the university so that appropriate arrangements can be made. The information booth also handles the organisation and participation of differently-abled students in the international exchange programmes offered by the University. Each Department appoints a professor to serve as a reference for differently-abled students studying within that department. These professors serve as consultants for the planning and improvement of services offered to differently-abled students, identifying didactic and technical support systems including tutoring and interpretation services. Specialised tutoring This is a tutoring service which is personalised based on the disability type, severity of the disability and the student's individual learning needs. Tutors are chosen who possess specific expertise relative to the student's chosen degree programme. Tutors are also chosen taking into consideration the academic year in progress based on the annual plan formulated with the department advisor. Student sustainment service This service is provided upon request by students in need of assistance in attending certain courses, taking exams, gaining access to the libraries, completing the necessary bureaucratic forms, and taking part in various activities organised by each department. Computers for visually challenged students Computers are available at the L.I.F.U, the computer laboratory at the Humanities Department, located in Via del Verzaro, 59, Perugia.
